subject: Discovery recap + proposed Mutual Action Plan for MedNova
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@mednova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed Mutual Action Plan for MedNova

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed mutual action plan (attached) so we have alignment on next steps.

High-level pain / goals (as I heard them)
- Current on-prem pipeline is spiking inference cost at peak; SREs are worried about burst capacity and tail latency for clinical search.
- Data residency and auditability are hard requirements for any vendor.
- Timeline: pilot in Q2 with production decision in early Q3 if SLA and cost targets check out.

Goals we agreed to
- Prove 99th percentile latency under 350ms for 256-token requests in your sandbox workload
- Demonstrate predictable monthly unit cost within a 10% variance window during a 30-day pilot
- Verify audit logs and KMS integration for PHI-scoped flows

Proposed mutual action plan (draft) — owners & target dates
1) Week of Feb 23: Sandbox access + test dataset (MedNova) — Owner: MedNova (Alex)
2) Feb 25: Redwood provides pilot config, deployment runbook, and estimated pricing — Owner: Redwood (Rachel / Ben)
3) Mar 2: Performance verification run (joint) — Owner: Tech leads (MedNova + Redwood)
4) Mar 9: Security evidence handoff (SOC2, KMS integration notes) — Owner: Redwood (Ben)
5) Mar 16: Pilot review & go/no-go decision — Owner: Exec sponsors (MedNova + Redwood)

Open items for you to confirm
- Final list of test accounts and a point of contact for the sandbox ingestion (name + email)
- Procurement cadence and PO timeline (loop procurement if needed)

Attachments: MedNova_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft)

If that aligns, I’ll lock the dates and schedule the kickoff.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0149

Rachel — appreciate the clean recap. This matches our notes. A few quick items: 

• I’ll send the sandbox dataset and a technical contact (Jordan Li) by EOD Friday.
• Procurement: looping in procurement@mednova.com so they can flag any contract constraints early.
• Security: we need SOC2 Type 2 evidence and an outline of how you handle KMS/HSM for keys that protect PHI.
• Pricing: please include a short view of dedicated vs hosted for the pilot (monthly committed vs burst) — procurement will want both scenarios.

On timing, Feb 25 for configuration and pricing looks doable. We prefer Mar 2 for the joint verification run; team availability OK.

Onward —

Alex — thanks for the quick reply and for looping procurement in. Short answers and next artifacts below.

1) SOC2 + KMS: attaching SOC2_Type2_REDWOOD.pdf and a short note on KMS integration. TL;DR: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or a cloud HSM; audit logs are retained per your retention policy during the pilot.
2) Pricing snapshot: attaching MedNova_pricing-dedicated.pdf — includes committed monthly pricing for a 4x GPU pool (expected pilot baseline) and burst credits for traffic spikes. I called out an example run-rate for your 256-token average payload.
3) Technical contact request: please confirm Jordan Li (jordan.li@mednova.com) as the sandbox ingestion owner. We’ll schedule an onboarding/ingestion runbook session next week.

Attachment stubs:
- SOC2_Type2_REDWOOD.pdf (security pack)
- MedNova_pricing-dedicated.pdf (pricing scenarios)
